name: u14-teammate-reads-shared
about: A teammate in the same company reads a shared record: grant read (policy) + record read. Rate: 50/day (plan A-TYP); measured founder sharing:dependencyRead 725/day [L], x K = 13/day. Grants: 12 = 676 founder sharing records x K [S o03], 388 B.
